title: Simple Terminals
description: A simple Crafting Terminal that lets you access and craft directly from connected storage.
body:
Crafting Terminal is a lightweight and powerful utility block designed to simplify storage interaction and crafting. Attach it to a storage block, browse everything through a clean scrollable interface, and craft directly using stored items with the built-in crafting grid.

# Features | Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | Unified Storage Access | Access attached storage from a single interface | | Automatic Inventory Detection | Automatically detects compatible inventories, including modded storage | | Scrollable Inventory | Browse large storage systems through a clean, scrollable interface | | Built-In Crafting Grid | Craft directly from the terminal with real-time output | | Stored Item Crafting | Use stored items while crafting through the terminal | | Sophisticated Storage Support | Works with the Storage Controller from Sophisticated Storage | | Simple Placement | Attach the terminal to a chest or compatible modded storage block | | Minimal Design | Fast, intuitive, and focused interface | # Storage Access Place the **Crafting Terminal** on a compatible storage block such as a chest or modded storage and right-click it to access the inventory through one clean interface. The large, scrollable inventory makes browsing bigger storage systems easier. # Sophisticated Storage Integration Crafting Terminal works seamlessly with the **Storage Controller** from **Sophisticated Storage**. This allows the terminal to provide convenient access to storage setups managed through the Storage Controller. # Built-In Crafting The terminal includes a **built-in crafting grid with real-time output**. Browse stored items and craft directly through the same interface for a faster and cleaner storage workflow. # How It Works 1. Place the **Crafting Terminal** attached to a storage block. 2. Right-click the terminal to open the interface. 3. Browse and scroll through stored items. 4. Craft directly using the built-in crafting grid. # Recipe Craft the terminal using: * **Crafting Table** * **Redstone Torch** * **Chest** * **Diamond** # Why Choose Crafting Terminal? 1. **One Storage Interface** — Access compatible attached storage from one place. 2. **Built-In Crafting** — Browse items and craft through the same interface. 3. **Large Storage Support** — Scroll through inventories built for massive storage systems. 4. **Automatic Detection** — Compatible inventories are detected automatically. 5. **Modded Storage Support** — Works with compatible modded storage. 6. **Sophisticated Storage Integration** — Works with the Storage Controller from Sophisticated Storage. 7. **Simple Workflow** — Place, open, browse, and craft. 8. **Minimal Design** — Focused on fast and intuitive storage management. # Community & Support * Discord: https://discord.gg/TJc3CxR4jK * GitHub: https://github.com/MeherBenSalem * Website: https://nightbeam.dev * Store: https://nightbeam.dev/store * CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/members/nightbeamstudio/projects * Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/organization/nightbeam
